title: Predictability and Surprise in Large Generative Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. A fabricated example of an AI making an offensive religious statement ('the Palestinians have no god') is used to illustrate factual inaccuracy, not to measure religious bias.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the general properties of predictability and surprise in large language models.
